description: Point-in-Time Wider US Individual Equities Universe combining S&P 500 LargeCap (2006+), S&P 400 MidCap (2011+), and S&P 600 SmallCap (2018+) constituents. Strictly excludes all ETFs/ETNs/trusts.

tradability_filters.execution_convention: Signal generated on Close[t], executed at Close[t+1] (or strictly causal t+1) with 5/10 bps slippage/fee stress
